internalResellers.description: Manual wallet credits require prior administrative approval. Once approved and credited to the reseller's account, such credits are final, non-refundable, non-transferable, and may only be used to activate services within the Platform. Manual credits cannot be exchanged for cash or reversed under any circumstances except where required by applicable law.

publicUsersAndResellers.description: Payments processed through approved automated payment gateways are verified server-side before activation. paymentStructure.title: 4. PAYMENT STRUCTURE
